2. Prosecution case, in short, is that on 12-9-1989, the informant sowed 'Mashkalai' in 26 decimals of land of Plot No. 440 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 170 of Mouza 'Sharbandia' and at the southwest of his house. On 13-9-1989 at about 7-00 AM the appellants and another went to the land to plough. Appellant Khaleque Fakir was ploughing the land. Appellant Mannan Fakir was sowing seeds of 'Mashkalai' Appellants Mansur Fakir, Meghu Fakir alias Geda Fakir and another co-accused Fazal were standing on the land. The informant, his brother Abdur Razzak and along with their cousin Pannu Fakir asked them not to plough the land. When Razzak Fakir' and Pannu Fakir stood before the plough, appellant Mansur Fakir ordered 'to catch them'. At once Fazlu brought out a knife from his waist and stabbed at the left chest of his brother Razzak Fakir and caused a serious wound. Fazlu Fakir also stabbed Razzak Fakir below of his left thigh. Falling on the ground, Abdur Razzak died. Appellant Mansur Fakir also brought out a knife from his waist and stabbed at the abdomen of Pannu Fakir and caused a serious wound. He also stabbed below of the left knee of Pannu Fakir. After the death of Abdur Razzak, the accused ran away towards the north. Samad Fakir, Halim Fakir, Kamala Bibi, Ishaque Fakir, Nayan Fakir, Saber, Abu Mohammad Fakir, Akkas Fakir and others came to the place of occurrence, and heard and saw the incident. 

 7. Salim Fakir, the informant was examined as PW 1. He stated in support of his FIR that on 13- 9-1989 the appellant Fazal Fakir was destroying by ploughing the 'Mashkalai' sowed previous day. When Razzak Fakir and Pannu Fakir asked them not to plough, Mansur Fakir ordered 'catch and kill them'. Immediately thereafter, Fazlal Fakir brought out a knife from his waist and stabbed at the left chest of Razzak Fakir and caused serious injuries. He also stabbed at the left thigh of Razzak Fakir. Razzak Fakir fell down on the ground and succumbed to his injuries. Mansur Fakir stabbed Pannu Fakir twice at his abdomen causing serious injuries. Appellant Khaleque Fakir was ploughing and Megu Fakir was sowing seed. Pannu Fakir was sent to the Faridpur Sadar Hospital for treatment. He further testified that his father purchased the land from the appellant Megu Fakir by a registered sale deed being No. 6911 dated 6-10-1988. His father also possessed 26 decimals land of Plot No. 360 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 153. After the death of his father in the month of 'Chaitra' before last some one day the accused went to possess the land of said Plot No. 360 and asked him to enjoy the land of Plot No. 440. Then, they sowed jute in 26 decimals land of Plot No. 440. In last 'Bhadra' they cut and took away the jute. Mansur Fakir lodged GD entry No. 559 dated 21-8-1989 over the cutting of jute. There was a 'Salish' but nothing could be settled. He adduced said registered deed which was marked as Exhibit-3. 

 28. On recall, PW 1 the informant further deposed that the entire land of Plot No. 440 was 1.41 acres. There were three co-sharers. They were enjoying the land of Plot No. 360 in exchange of that land. There were three co-sharers. He had no knowledge that Megu Fakir sold the land from the Plot No. 360. He did not know what the entire land of plot No. 360 was. He also deposed that to the adjacent north of Plot No. 440 was the land of Aziz Master and Moslem Mollah and to the north was the land of Aftab Fakir. The land was never partitioned. There were poles surrounding his land 26 decimals of land of Plot No. 440 recorded in the name of his mother, sister and himself. He filed the Khatian, which was marked as Exhibit 11. 

 37. As stated above, the prosecution case is that on 13-9-1989 at about 7-00 AM the appellants and one Fazal Fakir, who was absconding since before the trial entered into the land of the informant measuring 26 decimals of Plot No. 440 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 170. Khaleque Fakir was ploughing the land. Mannan Fakir was sowing seeds of 'Kalai'. The informant, his brother Razzak Fakir and cousin Pannu Fakir came to the land and asked them not to destroy the 'Kalai' sowed yeasterday. They did not care when Razzak Fakir and Mannan Fakir stood up before the plough to resist, Mansur Fakir ordered catch them, kill them. At once, Fazal Fakir stabbed at the left chest of Razzak. He fell down on the ground. Then, Fazal Fakir again stabbed him at his thigh. He succumbed to his injuries instantly. Then, Mansur Fakir stabbed twice at the abdomen of PW 6 Pannu Fakir.
